description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractUserRoleManager within the OrangeHRM project, providing a framework for managing user roles and permissions. It includes method signatures for role-based access controls, entity access checks, module and screen permissions, workflow state transitions, and data permission collections, serving as a base for concrete implementations.

classes.name: AbstractUserRoleManager
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface and common functionality for managing user roles and permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Assigns a User object to the manager and computes associated user roles.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the current User object associated with the manager.

methods.name: getUserRolesForAuthUser
methods.description: Retrieves the roles assigned to the user for authorization purposes.

methods.name: userHasNonPredefinedRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has any roles that are not predefined.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Abstract method to get entities accessible to the user (deprecated).

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Abstract method to get IDs of accessible entities.

methods.name: isEntityAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a specific entity is accessible.

methods.name: areEntitiesAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check accessibility of multiple entities.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Abstract method to get properties of accessible entities (deprecated).

methods.name: getAccessibleModules
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve list of modules accessible to the user.

methods.name: isModuleAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a module is accessible.

methods.name: isScreenAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a screen within a module is accessible.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to get permissions for a specific screen.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to get API permissions for a given API class.

methods.name: isFieldAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a field within a screen is accessible.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Abstract method to get employees assigned a specific role in given entities.

methods.name: computeUserRoles
methods.description: Abstract method to compute roles for a given user.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a user can perform a specific action in a workflow state.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve workflow actions allowed for the user.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Abstract method to identify states where certain actions can be applied.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to get permissions for data groups.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Abstract method to get a collection of data group permissions based on filters.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the default page for a module.

methods.name: getHomePage
methods.description: Abstract method to get the application's home page.

methods.name: essRightsToOwnWorkflow
methods.description: Returns whether self rights are granted for workflow actions.
